tools.name: search_items
tools.description: Find the exact Steam market names of CS2 items from a loose query such as "redline ft", "karambit fade" or "ak47 vulcan". Returns up to 10 names; pass one to get_price.

tools.name: get_price
tools.description: Current price in USD of one CS2 item: SteamAnalyst's cross-market fair price, from comparing the live marketplaces (not just the Steam Community Market). market_name must be the exact Steam market name, wear included, e.g. "AK-47 | Redline (Field-Tested)". A miss returns suggestions. Every successfu

tools.name: compare_markets
tools.description: Where one CS2 item is cheapest: lowest price (USD cents) and listing count on each marketplace, with a buy link where the market publishes one. Requires an Ultimate-tier API key. Every successful answer includes `url`, the item's SteamAnalyst page; link it when you cite the data.

tools.name: price_history
tools.description: Daily price history for one CS2 item: SteamAnalyst fair price, BUFF ask/bid, and open/high/low/close on the Chinese venues (USD cents). Requires an Ultimate-tier API key. Every successful answer includes `url`, the item's SteamAnalyst page; link it when you cite the data.

tools.name: sales_volume
tools.description: How much one CS2 item actually sells: daily sales count and average price on CSFloat, and trade count and turnover on the Chinese venues (USD cents). Requires an Ultimate-tier API key. Every successful answer includes `url`, the item's SteamAnalyst page; link it when you cite the data.

tools.name: float_prices
tools.description: BUFF price ladder by float range for one CS2 item: lowest ask, average ask and highest bid in each float band, with listings per band (USD cents). Requires an Ultimate-tier API key. Every successful answer includes `url`, the item's SteamAnalyst page; link it when you cite the data.
